description: This file implements a Kubernetes controller for managing device taint evictions, handling resource claims, resource slices, and pod evictions based on device taints and rules. It includes logic for tracking device taints, resource claims, and pod eviction timing, as well as event handling and status updates.

classes.name: Controller
classes.description: Main controller struct managing device taint evictions, resource claims, slices, and pod evictions.

classes.name: taintRuleStats
classes.description: Tracks statistics related to eviction rules, such as number of evicted pods.

classes.name: poolID
classes.description: Identifier for a resource pool, combining driver and pool names.

classes.name: pool
classes.description: Represents a collection of resource slices and manages their state.

classes.name: taintedDevice
classes.description: Represents a device with a specific taint.

classes.name: allocatedClaim
classes.description: Represents a resource claim with its eviction timing info.

classes.name: evictionAndReason
classes.description: Combines eviction time with reasons for eviction.

classes.name: evictionReason
classes.description: A list of taints that caused eviction, with string representation.

classes.name: trackedTaint
classes.description: Augments a device taint with its origin (rule or slice).

classes.name: sliceDeviceTaint
classes.description: References a specific taint entry in a resource slice device.

classes.name: workItem
classes.description: Represents a unit of work in the queue, either pod eviction or rule status update.

methods.name: addSlice
methods.description: Adds a resource slice to the pool, updating max generation.

methods.name: removeSlice
methods.description: Removes a resource slice from the pool, updating max generation.

methods.name: getTaintedDevices
methods.description: Returns all device taints with NoExecute effect, sorted by device name.

methods.name: getDevice
methods.description: Looks up a device by name, ignoring outdated slices.

methods.name: deviceTaint
methods.description: Returns the device taint from a trackedTaint, either from rule or slice.

methods.name: String
methods.description: String representation of evictionReason.

methods.name: equal
methods.description: Checks equality of two evictionAndReason instances.

methods.name: Compare
methods.description: Compares two trackedTaint instances.

methods.name: evictPod
methods.description: Schedules eviction of a pod at a specified time.

methods.name: cancelEvict
methods.description: Cancels scheduled eviction of a pod.

methods.name: worker
methods.description: Worker loop processing work items until shutdown.

methods.name: maybeDeletePod
methods.description: Attempts to delete a pod if eviction time has arrived.

methods.name: addConditionAndDeletePod
methods.description: Adds eviction condition to pod and deletes it.

methods.name: podEvictionTime
methods.description: Determines eviction time for a pod based on resource claims and taints.

methods.name: handleClaimChange
methods.description: Handles updates to resource claims, updating eviction info.

methods.name: claimEvictionTime
methods.description: Calculates earliest eviction time for a claim based on device taints.

methods.name: allEvictingDeviceTaints
methods.description: Iterates over all device taints with NoExecute effect affecting a device.

methods.name: ruleMatchesDevice
methods.description: Checks if a device taint rule matches a specific device.

methods.name: handleRuleChange
methods.description: Handles updates to device taint rules, updating eviction rules and statuses.

methods.name: handleSliceChange
methods.description: Handles updates to resource slices, updating pools and affected claims.

methods.name: usesDevice
methods.description: Checks if a resource allocation uses any of the modified devices.

methods.name: handlePodChange
methods.description: Handles updates to pod objects, scheduling eviction if needed.

methods.name: podEvictionTime
methods.description: Determines eviction time for a pod based on resource claims and taints.

methods.name: cancelWorkWithEvent
methods.description: Cancels eviction work and emits cancellation event.

methods.name: emitPodDeletionEvent
methods.description: Emits an event indicating a pod is marked for deletion.

methods.name: emitCancelPodDeletionEvent
methods.description: Emits an event indicating a pod eviction cancellation.

methods.name: newNamespacedName
methods.description: Creates a NamespacedName from a metav1.Object.

methods.name: newObject
methods.description: Creates a tainteviction.NamespacedObject from a metav1.Object.
